title: Think Twice  because each side gets hot
text: Think Twice  because each side gets hot. [[VIDEOID:b059e9f722ed4a25f365908c2ba52cbb]] I like the chrome look, features, and how it toast ...But think twice before you buy!  The top does get hot and after I cooked several slices of toast on one side the side DOES get HOT after repeated use.  Only use this toaster far away from everything.  I think today ALL toasters should be cool touch on the sides!!!

product_metadata.title: Toaster 4 Slice Wide Slot Stainless Steel Toasters with Bagel, Reheat, Cancel, Defrost Function, 6 Shade Settings, Removable Crumb Tray, 1550W, Aigostar
features: 🥯【Dual Controls Toaster】Features 2 independent control panels to prepare different types of bread with different browning levels at the same time. This stainless steel toaster can be a big time saver and perfect for the whole family.
🥪【Custom Browning Control】 6-setting browning dials, plus Reheat, Defrost, Cancel and Bagel functions with LED indicators will help you get that perfect golden hue no matter what you’re toasting.

🍔【1.6 inch Wide Toasting Slots】Extra wide toaster slots allow for a wide variety of items to be toasted with the prime toaster. Like sliced bread, French toast (thick & thin) , bagel, frozen pancakes, frozen waffles or other toaster pastries.

🍩【Easy to Store & Easy to Clean】Even with 4-slice capacity, the breakfast toaster is compact and easy to clean. Removalble crumb tray on both side makes cleaning could never be easier! Convenient cord storage on the bottom helps to keep your kitchen countertop tidy!

🍞【Safety & Reliable】ETL certificated. This bagel toaster made of premium stainless steel that is approved by ETL, offers you the maximum safety and reliability. A nice gift choice for your mom and friends.
